sys_remote_update_set.name: STRY0012345 - Incident auto-assignment
sys_remote_update_set.description: Route new incidents to the right group automatically and escalate P1s.

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_a1000000000000000000000000000001
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>a1000000000000000000000000000001</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_created_by>jane.dev</sys_created_by><sys_updated_by>jane.dev</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-30 10:15:00</sys_updated_on><name>IncidentAssignmentUtils</name><api_name>global.IncidentAssignmentUtils</api_name><client_callable>true</client_callable><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><script>var IncidentAssignmentUtils = Class.create();
IncidentAssignmentUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    // Finds the support group for a category using the u_assignment_matrix table.
    getGroupForCategory: function(category, location) {
        var matrix = new GlideRecord('u_assignment_matrix');
        matrix.addQuery('u_category', category);
        matrix.addQuery('u_location', location);
        matrix.addActiveQuery();
        matrix.orderBy('u_priority');
        matrix.setLimit(1);
        matrix.query();
        if (matrix.next()) {
            return matrix.getValue('u_group');
        }
        // Fall back to the default service desk group configured in a property
        return gs.getProperty('x_acme.incident.default_group');
    },

    /* Called from the client script via GlideAjax */
    ajaxGetGroup: function() {
        var category = this.getParameter('sysparm_category');
        var location = this.getParameter('sysparm_location');
        var groupId = this.getGroupForCategory(category, location);
        var group = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        if (group.get(groupId)) {
            return JSON.stringify({ sys_id: groupId, name: group.getDisplayValue() });
        }
        return '';
    },

    type: 'IncidentAssignmentUtils'
});</script><description>Looks up the right support group for an incident from the assignment matrix.</description></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_b1000000000000000000000000000001
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>b1000000000000000000000000000001</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_created_by>jane.dev</sys_created_by><sys_updated_by>jane.dev</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-30 10:15:00</sys_updated_on><name>Auto-assign incident by category</name><collection>incident</collection><when>before</when><order>100</order><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_update>false</action_update><advanced>true</advanced><active>true</active><condition>current.category.changes() || current.assignment_group.nil()</condition><script>(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // Only auto-assign when the caller did not pick a group
    if (!current.assignment_group.nil())
        return;

    var utils = new IncidentAssignmentUtils();
    var groupId = utils.getGroupForCategory(current.getValue('category'), current.getValue('location'));
    if (groupId) {
        current.assignment_group = groupId;
        current.work_notes = 'Auto-assigned by category matrix';
        gs.eventQueue('x_acme.incident.auto_assigned', current, groupId, current.getValue('category'));
    } else {
        gs.addErrorMessage('No assignment group found for this category. Please choose one.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
})(current, previous);</script><description>Sets the assignment group on new incidents using the category matrix.</description></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_b1000000000000000000000000000002
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>b1000000000000000000000000000002</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_created_by>jane.dev</sys_created_by><sys_updated_by>jane.dev</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-30 10:15:00</sys_updated_on><name>Sync priority to incident tasks</name><collection>incident</collection><when>after</when><order>200</order><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_update>true</action_update><advanced>true</advanced><active>true</active><filter_condition>priorityVALCHANGES^EQ</filter_condition><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Copy the priority to all child tasks so SLAs stay aligned
    var task = new GlideRecord('incident_task');
    task.addQuery('incident', current.sys_id);
    task.query();
    while (task.next()) {
        task.priority = current.priority;
        task.update();
    }
    current.u_last_priority_sync = new GlideDateTime();
    current.update();
    gs.log('Priority synced for ' + current.number);
})(current, previous);</script><description /></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>d1000000000000000000000000000001</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_created_by>jane.dev</sys_created_by><sys_updated_by>jane.dev</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-30 10:15:00</sys_updated_on><name>Re-route stale default group incidents</name><run_type>daily</run_type><run_time>1970-01-01 02:00:00</run_time><active>true</active><script>// Nightly: re-route incidents stuck in the default group for more than 4 hours
var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
gr.addEncodedQuery('active=true^assignment_group=d625dccec0a8016700a222a0f7900d06^sys_updated_onRELATIVELT@hour@ago@4');
gr.query();
var utils = new IncidentAssignmentUtils();
while (gr.next()) {
    var groupId = utils.getGroupForCategory(gr.getValue('category'), gr.getValue('location'));
    if (groupId) {
        gr.assignment_group = groupId;
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        gr.update();
    }
}</script><description>Nightly clean-up of incidents parked in the default group.</description></sysauto_script></record_update>
